0.9.6 is a diagnostic build: prove each Titan backlight layer independently before changing the automatic policy again.
Use the diagnostic lab below before running automatic lighting.
Turn on below 10 lux. Turn off at 15 lux.
The automatic policy is intentionally unchanged in this diagnostic build. Use the sensor-only monitor below to test wake behavior without touching the keyboard.
Use this room as the threshold
Diagnostic lab · isolate one layer at a time
These tests are deliberately separate. Manual hold performs one vendor write and then NightKeys leaves it alone—even across screen off/on. The monitor tests never write the keyboard at all.
Live vendor values not refreshed yet.
Manual continuous timeout · no sensor / no screen logic

Turn this on, wait longer than the stock timeout, lock the phone, unlock it, and come back here. NightKeys will not write 0 on screen-off and will not use the light sensor. The original timeout is saved before the write.
Force OFF test · write 0 + close-light broadcast

NightKeys will save the current vendor timeout, write 2147483647 once, verify the readback, then do absolutely nothing to the keyboard until you manually restore it. Do not use the stock keyboard-light Quick Settings tile during this test.
NightKeys will save the current timeout, write 0, send the vendor close-light broadcast, and then leave the setting alone until you restore it.
The automatic 90-second test below is the old integrated path and is intentionally unchanged. Use it only after the isolated tests tell us which layers are reliable.
In the phone’s Keyboard backlight settings, select the lowest brightness that still visibly lights the keys. NightKeys leaves that stock brightness setting untouched.
Set the stock keyboard slider to the lowest visible level, then confirm it here.
This still exercises the complete 0.9.5 sensor + screen + timeout state machine. It is kept unchanged so its behavior can be compared against the isolated tests.
Resume automation after restart, once Shizuku is available
Keep NightKeys unrestricted in the phone’s battery settings. Diagnostic monitor modes use a foreground notification but do not modify the keyboard.
Stop automation / restore pending hardware change
Before uninstalling or clearing app data, restore any pending diagnostic or automatic hardware change. A pending recovery journal is the safety copy of your original timeout.

First set the phone’s keyboard brightness slider to the lowest level that visibly lights the keys. NightKeys will leave that stock brightness setting untouched.

This runs the existing 0.9.5 automatic policy. For diagnosis, first prefer the isolated lab tests because they separate vendor persistence, screen behavior, app lifecycle and light-sensor wake events.
